name: Koa Health
one_liner: Self-guided CBT, mindfulness and sleep app (Koa Care 360, formerly Koa Foundations), free through employers and health plans.
best_for: Adults whose employer, health plan or provider offers Koa
People with everyday stress, low mood, anxiety or poor sleep who want self-guided CBT and mindfulness exercises
People who want short daily activities on their phone
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People without access through an employer, health plan or provider (no individual sign-up)
People with severe depression or other serious illness who need a clinician
short_description: Self-guided mental health app from Koa Health, available as a benefit through employers, health plans and providers; earlier versions were called Koa.
long_description: Koa Health is a digital mental health company, spun out of Telefónica, that sells to employers, health plans, health systems and providers. People reach it through the Koa Care 360 app (previously Koa Foundations), which you sign into with an email your employer or provider has registered; it is free to you and open to employees and their dependents aged 18 and over. The app offers short activities drawn from cognitive behavioral therapy, mindfulness and positive psychology, aimed at stress, sleep, anxiety and well-being. Koa also builds therapist-supported programs (for child anxiety, teen social anxiety, adult PTSD and social anxiety) and the Koa Mindset depression tool for clinics; it describes these as not reviewed or cleared by the FDA. A randomized trial of Koa Foundations in more than 1,000 NHS staff, published in the British Journal of Psychiatry in 2022, found small improvements in distress, well-being and insomnia over 8 weeks; Koa also reports a smaller COVID-era trial.
patient_summary: If your employer, health plan or provider offers Koa, you download the Koa Care 360 app and sign in with your registered email; there is no charge to you. You then work through short CBT, mindfulness and sleep activities on your phone. It is self-help, not therapy, and it is for adults.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer, health plan or provider
pricing.notes: No individual purchase. Organizations contract with Koa Health; access is for employees and dependents aged 18+.

privacy.notes: Koa's privacy policy could not be opened for this review; the App Store label lists health, contact and usage data linked to you and declares no tracking.

seo.title: Koa Health: Clinical Digital Therapeutics for Mental Health
seo.meta_description: Koa Health offers 7 digital CBT products for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and BDD. 65 peer-reviewed publications, 21 clinical trials. Enterprise platform for...

faqs.a: Koa Mindset is currently a wellness device not FDA reviewed/cleared. Koa Health is pursuing FDA clearance through pivotal clinical trials for some products.

faqs.q: What conditions does Koa Health treat?
faqs.a: Koa Health offers digital CBT products for depression, anxiety, PTSD, body dysmorphic disorder (BDD), and OCD.

Koa Care 360, launched in August 2024, is a unified mental health platform that spans from prevention to clinical treatment, with preventive care, online therapy, and personalized care mapping. It received 100% clinical assurance rating from ORCHA.

faqs.q: How is Koa Health clinically validated?
faqs.a: Koa Health's products are backed by 65 peer-reviewed publications, 27 patents, and 21 clinical trials including RCTs conducted with academic partners like Massachusetts General Hospital and the London School of Economics.

clinical_trials.study: England-wide RCT of Koa Foundations in NHS healthcare workers (King's College London)

citation.authors: Gnanapragasam SN, Tinch-Taylor R, Scott HR, Hegarty S, Souliou E, Bhundia R, Lamb D, Weston D, Greenberg N, Madan I, Stevelink S, Raine R, Carter B, Wessely S
citation.title: Multicentre, England-wide randomised controlled trial of the 'Foundations' smartphone application in improving mental health and well-being in a healthcare worker population

clinical_trials.outcome: App users had small but significant improvements in distress and well-being and less insomnia at 4 and 8 weeks versus control.

availability.note: Only through an employer, health plan or provider that contracts with Koa Health; adults 18+.
